title: Facilitate a timed agenda
objective: Adapt the agenda to a 45-minute slot without dropping commitments.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Visioning time goes quickly. A timed agenda with visible checkpoints keeps the session on track toward its decisions.

blocks.caption: A practical 60-minute agenda (course default)
head: Segment
Minutes
Output
rows: Shared understanding of the decision the group will make
Business goals confirmed in the customer's words
Candidate workflows captured in the use case log
Owners, next steps, and Day-in-the-Life participants

blocks.x: This timing is the course's recommended default. It sits within the ranges in Glean's Visioning playbook, which allows 10–15 minutes for context, 15–20 for discovery, 15–20 for prioritization, and 5 for recap and next steps.

items: **By minute 15:** the business outcome is clear.
**By minute 35:** the candidate list is captured.
**By minute 55:** priorities and their rationale are agreed.

blocks.x: Assign a dedicated note-taker so the facilitator can listen.

Durations differ across Glean sources. When you have less time, cut scope deliberately: cover fewer departments, pre-populate the list from pre-work, and shorten context. Always keep **prioritization** and the **owner and next-step commitments**. Without them, the session produces no decision. If you can't complete enough discovery properly, schedule a second session rather than rushing.
Visible checkpoints keep a 60-minute session on track. If you miss one, cut discovery, not prioritization.

blocks.title: Where the 60 minutes go
blocks.alt: A bar chart of the 60-minute Visioning agenda: welcome and purpose 5 minutes, context and outcomes 10, opportunity discovery 20, prioritization 20, and commitments 5. Prioritization is emphasized because it should never be cut.

practice.x: The customer can only give you 45 minutes. Adapt the agenda without dropping commitments.

items: Context: 5 minutes, using a list pre-populated from pre-work.
Discovery: 12 minutes, limited to one department.

worked.x: If discovery isn't complete, agree a short second session for the remaining department rather than skipping prioritization or owners.
